chapters.title: Introduction to AI & Intelligent Agents
chapters.description: Discover what Artificial Intelligence truly is, explore the Turing Test, compare Narrow vs General AI, and understand how intelligent agents perceive and act in environments.

chapters.title: Foundations of Machine Learning
chapters.description: Transition from rules to learning from data. Master Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning, data preprocessing, and the fundamental bias-variance tradeoff.

chapters.title: Neural Networks & Perceptrons
chapters.description: Demystify the building blocks of modern AI. Trace biological inspiration to artificial neurons, master activation functions like ReLU and Softmax, and understand multi-layer forward passes.

chapters.title: Training Networks & Backpropagation
chapters.description: Learn how neural networks actually learn. Understand loss functions, master gradient descent, demystify the calculus of backpropagation, and explore modern optimizers like Adam.

chapters.title: Deep Learning & Computer Vision
chapters.description: Unlock visual intelligence with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Learn kernels, convolutions, feature maps, pooling layers, and modern image classification architectures.

chapters.title: Sequence Modeling & NLP (RNNs to Transformers)
chapters.description: Explore how machines process human language. Journey from word embeddings and tokenization through RNNs and LSTMs to the revolutionary Attention mechanism and Transformers.

chapters.title: Generative AI & Large Language Models
chapters.description: Delve into the generative frontier. Master modern LLMs, pre-training objectives, instruction tuning, RLHF, prompt engineering strategies, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

chapters.title: AI Ethics, Safety & Autonomous Frontiers
chapters.description: Navigate the critical challenges of modern AI: algorithmic bias, explainability (XAI), alignment, hallucination mitigation, autonomous agentic loops, and the path to AGI.
